lab=np.load(WORK/'labels.npy'); N=len(lab); folds=np.load(WORK/'folds.npy'); Y=np.eye(8)[lab]
R = [601, 222, 88, 83, 444, 506, 254, 495]; keep=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),R)
M=np.load(WORK/'base_mean.npy'); E12=np.load(WORK/'ed1_cls12.npy')
P=practice()
X=np.concatenate([M[l][:,keep] for l in [2,6,10]]+[E12[:,keep]],1)
o=np.zeros((N,8))
for f in range(5):
    tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
    mu=X[tr].mean(0); sd=X[tr].std(0)+1e-6; Z=(X[tr]-mu)/sd
    al=np.linalg.solve(Z@Z.T+300*np.eye(tr.sum()),Y[tr]-Y[tr].mean(0)); o[te]=((X[te]-mu)/sd)@(Z.T@al)
pred=o.argmax(1); np.save(WORK/'oof_joint_pred.npy',o)
cm=np.zeros((8,8),int)
for t,p in zip(lab,pred): cm[t,p]+=1
print(cm)
from collections import Counter
err=np.where(pred!=lab)[0]
print('by register', Counter(P[i]['register'] for i in err), 'by line', Counter(P[i]['line'] for i in err))
for i in err[:40]:
    print(f"[{LABELS[lab[i]][:10]} -> {LABELS[pred[i]][:10]}] {P[i]['text'][:160]}")
